item.title: Murmur 1.9
item.description:
Settings you can find things in

Settings is now three tabs instead of two. Words holds your vocabulary corrections and snippets, which were the bulkiest thing in the old General pane.

The AI tab is shorter too: automatic cleanup and manual polish were two nearly identical blocks and are now two rows under one Models heading, with the privacy warning shown only for automatic cleanup — the one engine that runs without being asked. Provider keys stay on the same tab as the models that need them.

About Murmur

There's a proper About panel in the app menu now, with the version and a way to find me. The same sits at the foot of Settings.

Created with ❤️ by Prayas.
